class Point(int id, int x, int y)

class Params(local string[][] rows)
    int[] eps := [for value := rows[0][1:][] then int(value)]
    min_pts := int(rows[1][1])
    max_eps := int(rows[2][1])
    int[] extract := [for value := rows[3][1:][] then int(value)]
    xi_text := rows[4][1]
    local ratio := xi_text.split("/")
    u := int(ratio[0])
    v := int(ratio[1])
    min_size := int(rows[5][1])
    width := int(rows[6][1])
    height := int(rows[6][2])
    k_width := int(rows[7][1])
    k_height := int(rows[7][2])
    plot_width := int(rows[8][1])

string[] lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    values := content.split(NL)
    return values[0:<int(#values) - 1]

Point[] read_points()
    Point[] points := []
    for line := lines("input/points.csv")[1:][]
        int[] row := [for field := line.split(",")[] then int(field)]
        points = points.append(Point(row[0], row[1], row[2]))
    ids := [for point := points[] then point.id].sorted()
    Point[] result := []
    for id := ids[]
        for point := points[]
            if point.id == id
                result = result.append(point)
                break
    return result

Params read_params()
    return Params([for line := lines("input/params.txt")[] then line.split(" ")])

class Result(int[] labels, bool[] core)

Result cluster(int[][] neighborhoods, int minimum)
    core := [for row := neighborhoods[] then int(#row) >= minimum]
    labels := array(#neighborhoods, fill = -2)
    number := 0
    for: index < int(#neighborhoods)
        if labels[index] != -2
            continue
        if not core[index]
            labels[index] = -1
            continue
        labels[index] = number
        queue := neighborhoods[index]
        head := 0
        while head < int(#queue)
            other := queue[head]
            head += 1
            if labels[other] == -1
                labels[other] = number
            elif labels[other] == -2
                labels[other] = number
                if core[other]
                    queue = queue.concat(neighborhoods[other])
        number += 1
    return Result(labels, core)

public import data = "./dataset.qui"

int distance(data.Point first, data.Point second)
    int dx := first.x - second.x
    int dy := first.y - second.y
    return dx * dx + dy * dy

class Cell(int x, int y, int[] members)
class Neighborhood(int[] members, int candidates)

string cell_key(int x, int y)
    return "{x},{y}"

int lookup(map<string, int> positions, string key)
    match positions.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return -1

class Grid(data.Point[] points, int radius)
    Cell[] cells := []
    positions := map<string, int>()
    for: index < int(#points)
        local point := points[index]
        local int x := point.x / radius
        local int y := point.y / radius
        local key := cell_key(x, y)
        local position := lookup(positions, key)
        if position < 0
            position = int(#cells)
            .positions.set(key, position)
            cells = cells.append(Cell(x, y, []))
        cells[position].members = cells[position].members.append(index)

    Neighborhood neighborhood(int index)
        point := points[index]
        int x := point.x / radius
        int y := point.y / radius
        int[] members := []
        candidates := 0
        for: y - 1 <= gy <= y + 1
            for: x - 1 <= gx <= x + 1
                position := -1
                match positions.get(cell_key(gx, gy))
                    int found
                        position = found
                    none
                        continue
                for other := cells[position].members[]
                    candidates += 1
                    if distance(point, points[other]) <= radius * radius
                        members = members.append(other)
        return Neighborhood(members, candidates)

    Cell busiest()
        best := cells[0]
        for cell := cells[]
            if #cell.members > #best.members or #cell.members == #best.members and (cell.y < best.y or cell.y == best.y and cell.x < best.x)
                best = cell
        return best

int[] brute_counts(data.Point[] points, int radius)
    int[] counts := []
    for point := points[]
        count := 0
        for other := points[]
            if distance(point, other) <= radius * radius
                count += 1
        counts = counts.append(count)
    return counts

import math
import dbscan = "./dbscan.qui"
import optics = "./optics.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

string pad_left(string value, int width)
    return " " * nat(math.max(0, width - int(#value))) + value

string joined(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then "{value}"].join(" ")

string label_char(int label)
    if label < 0
        return "."
    letters := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    return if label < 52 then letters[label] else "#"

string value_text(int value)
    return if value == optics.infinite_distance() then "-" else "{value}"

string root(int value)
    return if value == optics.infinite_distance() then "-" else report.root(value)

string optional(int value)
    return if value < 0 then "-" else "{value}"

string check(bool value)
    return if value then "ok" else "mismatch"

string condition(bool value)
    return if value then "ok" else "fail"

int integer_root(int value)
    low := 0
    high := value + 1
    while high - low > 1
        mid := (low + high) / 2
        if mid <= value / mid
            low = mid
        else
            high = mid
    return low

int suggested(int value)
    radius := integer_root(value)
    if radius * radius < value
        radius += 1
    return math.max(radius, 1)

int[] unique_sorted(int[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    int[] result := []
    for value := ordered[]
        if #result == 0 or value != result[-1]
            result = result.append(value)
    return result

class Curve(int[] source)
    int[] order := []
    for: point < int(#source)
        local position := int(#order)
        order = order.append(point)
        while position > 0 and source[point] > source[order[position - 1]]
            order[position] = order[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        order[position] = point
    int[] values := [for index := order[] then source[index]]
    knee := 0
    cross := -1
    for: index < int(#values)
        local current := math.abs((int(#values) - 1) * (values[index] - values[0]) - (values[-1] - values[0]) * index)
        if current > cross
            cross = current
            knee = index
    int eps := suggested(values[knee])

class GridSummary(optics.grid.data.Point[] points, int radius)
    local index := optics.grid.Grid(points, radius)
    int[][] neighborhoods := []
    candidates := 0
    cells := int(#index.cells)
    optics.grid.Cell busiest := index.busiest()
    int[] sizes := [for cell := index.cells[] then int(#cell.members)].sorted()
    occupancy_sizes := unique_sorted(sizes)
    int[] occupancy_counts := []
    for size := occupancy_sizes[]
        occupancy_counts = occupancy_counts.append(int(#[for value := sizes[] if value == size then value]))
    local int[] brute := optics.grid.brute_counts(points, radius)
    local total := 0
    local brute_total := 0
    consistent := true
    for: point < int(#points)
        local optics.grid.Neighborhood row := index.neighborhood(point)
        neighborhoods = neighborhoods.append(row.members)
        candidates += row.candidates
        total += int(#row.members)
        brute_total += brute[point]
        if int(#row.members) != brute[point]
            consistent = false
    int pairs := (total - int(#points)) / 2
    int brute_pairs := (brute_total - int(#points)) / 2

    string[] lines()
        string[] occupancy := []
        for: position < int(#occupancy_sizes)
            occupancy = occupancy.append("{occupancy_sizes[position]}:{occupancy_counts[position]}")
        return ["eps {radius} cells {cells} busiest {busiest.x} {busiest.y} {#busiest.members} candidates {candidates} pairs {pairs} brute_pairs {brute_pairs} " + check(consistent), "  occupancy " + occupancy.join(" ")]

class Setting(string name, string kind, int radius, int[] labels, bool[] core)
    int count := labels.max() + 1
    int[][] members := []
    for: label < count
        local int[] group := []
        for: point < int(#labels)
            if labels[point] == label
                group = group.append(point)
        members = members.append(group)
    noise := int(#[for label := labels[] if label < 0 then label])
    core_count := 0
    for: point < int(#labels)
        if labels[point] >= 0 and core[point]
            core_count += 1
    border := int(#labels) - noise - core_count

Setting db_setting(string name, int radius, int[][] neighborhoods, int minimum)
    result := dbscan.cluster(neighborhoods, minimum)
    return Setting(name, "dbscan", radius, result.labels, result.core)

dbscan.Result extract(int[] ordered, int[] reach, int[] core, int radius)
    limit := radius * radius
    labels := array(#core, fill = -1)
    number := -1
    for point := ordered[]
        if reach[point] > limit
            if core[point] <= limit
                number += 1
                labels[point] = number
        else
            labels[point] = number
    return dbscan.Result(labels, [for value := core[] then value <= limit])

class DownArea(int start, int finish, high := 0)
class SteepArea(string kind, int start, int finish)
class XiCluster(int start, int finish)
    size := finish - start + 1
    label := -1
    parent := -1
    int left := optics.infinite_distance()
    int right := optics.infinite_distance()
    int valley := optics.infinite_distance()

class Xi(int[] reach, optics.grid.data.Params params)
    count := int(#reach) - 1
    int alpha := (params.v - params.u) * (params.v - params.u)
    int beta := params.v * params.v
    bool[] steep_up := []
    bool[] steep_down := []
    bool[] up := []
    bool[] down := []
    for: position < count
        local current := reach[position]
        local following := reach[position + 1]
        local defined := current != optics.infinite_distance() or following != optics.infinite_distance()
        steep_up = steep_up.append(defined and xle(current, following))
        steep_down = steep_down.append(defined and xle(following, current))
        up = up.append(current < following)
        down = down.append(current > following)
    SteepArea[] areas := []
    XiCluster[] clusters := []
    local DownArea[] down_areas := []
    local index := 0
    local mib := 0
    for: start < count
        if start < index or not (steep_up[start] or steep_down[start])
            continue
        for: index <= position <= start
            mib = math.max(mib, reach[position])
        local DownArea[] retained := []
        if mib != optics.infinite_distance()
            for area := down_areas[]
                if xle(mib, reach[area.start])
                    area.high = math.max(area.high, mib)
                    retained = retained.append(area)
        down_areas = retained
        if steep_down[start]
            local int finish := region_end(start, steep_down, up)
            areas = areas.append(SteepArea("down", start, finish))
            down_areas = down_areas.append(DownArea(start, finish))
            index = finish + 1
            mib = reach[index]
        else
            local int finish := region_end(start, steep_up, down)
            areas = areas.append(SteepArea("up", start, finish))
            index = finish + 1
            mib = reach[index]
            local XiCluster[] candidates := []
            for area := down_areas[]
                local first := area.start
                local last := finish
                if not xle(area.high, reach[last + 1])
                    continue
                local top := reach[area.start]
                if xle(reach[last + 1], top)
                    while first < area.finish and reach[first + 1] > reach[last + 1]
                        first += 1
                elif xle(top, reach[last + 1])
                    while last > start and reach[last - 1] > top
                        last -= 1
                if last - first + 1 >= params.min_size and first <= area.finish and last >= start
                    candidates = candidates.append(XiCluster(first, last))
            clusters = clusters.concat(candidates[::-1])
    labels := array(nat(count), fill = -1)
    local next_label := 0
    for: number < int(#clusters)
        local cluster := clusters[number]
        local clear := true
        for: cluster.start <= position <= cluster.finish
            if labels[position] >= 0
                clear = false
        if clear
            cluster.label = next_label
            for: cluster.start <= position <= cluster.finish
                labels[position] = next_label
            next_label += 1
        cluster.left = reach[cluster.start]
        cluster.right = reach[cluster.finish + 1]
        for: cluster.start + 1 <= position <= cluster.finish
            cluster.valley = math.min(cluster.valley, reach[position])
        clusters[number] = cluster
    for: number < int(#clusters)
        local cluster := clusters[number]
        for: other < int(#clusters)
            local candidate := clusters[other]
            if other != number and candidate.start <= cluster.start and candidate.finish >= cluster.finish and (candidate.size > cluster.size or candidate.size == cluster.size and other > number)
                if cluster.parent < 0 or candidate.size < clusters[cluster.parent].size
                    cluster.parent = other
        clusters[number] = cluster

    bool xle(int first, int second)
        if second == optics.infinite_distance()
            return true
        if first == optics.infinite_distance()
            return false
        return beta * first <= alpha * second

    int region_end(int start, bool[] steep, bool[] reverse)
        finish := start
        flat := 0
        for: start <= position < count
            if steep[position]
                finish = position
                flat = 0
            elif reverse[position]
                break
            else
                flat += 1
                if flat > params.min_pts
                    break
        return finish

int turn(optics.grid.data.Point origin, optics.grid.data.Point first, optics.grid.data.Point second)
    return (first.x - origin.x) * (second.y - origin.y) - (first.y - origin.y) * (second.x - origin.x)

int[] hull_half(optics.grid.data.Point[] points, int[] ordered)
    int[] result := []
    for point := ordered[]
        while #result >= 2 and turn(points[result[-2]], points[result[-1]], points[point]) <= 0
            result = result[0:<int(#result) - 1]
        result = result.append(point)
    return result

int[] convex_hull(optics.grid.data.Point[] points, int[] members)
    int[] ordered := []
    for point := members[]
        position := int(#ordered)
        ordered = ordered.append(point)
        while position > 0 and (points[point].x < points[ordered[position - 1]].x or points[point].x == points[ordered[position - 1]].x and points[point].y < points[ordered[position - 1]].y)
            ordered[position] = ordered[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        ordered[position] = point
    if #ordered <= 2
        return ordered
    lower := hull_half(points, ordered)
    upper := hull_half(points, ordered[::-1])
    return lower[0:<int(#lower) - 1].concat(upper[0:<int(#upper) - 1])

string[] cluster_lines(optics.grid.data.Point[] points, Setting setting, int label)
    members := setting.members[label]
    size := int(#members)
    core_count := int(#[for point := members[] if setting.core[point] then point])
    int sx := [for point := members[] then points[point].x].sum()
    int sy := [for point := members[] then points[point].y].sum()
    medoid := -1
    best := 0
    for point := members[]
        int dx := size * points[point].x - sx
        int dy := size * points[point].y - sy
        value := dx * dx + dy * dy
        if medoid < 0 or value < best
            medoid = point
            best = value
    int xmin := [for point := members[] then points[point].x].min()
    int xmax := [for point := members[] then points[point].x].max()
    int ymin := [for point := members[] then points[point].y].min()
    int ymax := [for point := members[] then points[point].y].max()
    area := (xmax - xmin + 1) * (ymax - ymin + 1)
    hull := convex_hull(points, members)
    doubled := 0
    diameter := 0
    for: position < int(#hull)
        first := points[hull[position]]
        second := points[hull[(position + 1) % int(#hull)]]
        doubled += first.x * second.y - second.x * first.y
        for other := hull[]
            diameter = math.max(diameter, optics.grid.distance(first, points[other]))
    doubled = math.abs(doubled)
    area_text := "{doubled / 2}." + (if doubled % 2 == 0 then "0" else "5")
    return ["cluster {label} " + label_char(label) + " size {size} core {core_count} border {size - core_count} centroid " + report.fraction(sx, size) + " " + report.fraction(sy, size) + " medoid {points[medoid].id}", "  bbox {xmin} {ymin} {xmax} {ymax} area {area} density " + report.fraction(size, area), "  hull {#hull} hull_area {area_text} diameter_sq {diameter} diameter " + root(diameter)]

int pair_count(int count)
    return count * (count - 1) / 2

int pair_sum(int[] labels)
    result := 0
    for label := unique_sorted(labels)[]
        result += pair_count(int(#[for value := labels[] if value == label then value]))
    return result

string adjusted_rand(Setting first, Setting second)
    same := 0
    for a := unique_sorted(first.labels)[]
        for b := unique_sorted(second.labels)[]
            count := 0
            for: point < int(#first.labels)
                if first.labels[point] == a and second.labels[point] == b
                    count += 1
            same += pair_count(count)
    a_pairs := pair_sum(first.labels)
    b_pairs := pair_sum(second.labels)
    total := pair_count(int(#first.labels))
    numerator := 2 * (total * same - a_pairs * b_pairs)
    denominator := total * (a_pairs + b_pairs) - 2 * a_pairs * b_pairs
    return if denominator == 0 then report.ari(1, 1) else report.ari(numerator, denominator)

class Outlier(int point, int nearest, int distance)
class Plot(string[] rows, int knee_column)
class Analysis(optics.grid.data.Point[] points, optics.grid.data.Params params)
    count := int(#points)
    int k := params.min_pts - 1
    local int[][] neighbor_rows := []
    for: point < count
        local int[] values := []
        for: other < count
            if point != other
                values = values.append(optics.grid.distance(points[point], points[other]))
        neighbor_rows = neighbor_rows.append(values.sorted())
    Curve[] curves := []
    for: int rank < 2 * params.min_pts
        curves = curves.append(Curve([for row := neighbor_rows[] then row[rank]]))
    Curve curve := curves[k - 1]
    int[] kdist := [for row := neighbor_rows[] then row[k - 1]]
    int[] radii := unique_sorted(params.eps.concat([curve.eps, params.max_eps]))
    GridSummary[] grids := [for radius := radii[] then GridSummary(points, radius)]
    Setting[] settings := []
    for radius := params.eps[]
        settings = settings.append(db_setting("db{radius}", radius, neighborhoods(radius), params.min_pts))
    Setting knee := db_setting("knee{curve.eps}", curve.eps, neighborhoods(curve.eps), params.min_pts)
    settings = settings.append(knee)
    int[] core := optics.core_distances(points, neighborhoods(params.max_eps), params.min_pts)
    optics.Ordering ordering := optics.order(points, neighborhoods(params.max_eps), core)
    for radius := params.extract[]
        local result := extract(ordering.points, ordering.reach, core, radius)
        settings = settings.append(Setting("op{radius}", "extract", radius, result.labels, result.core))
    int[] positions := [for point := ordering.points[] then ordering.reach[point]].append(optics.infinite_distance())
    xi := Xi(positions, params)
    local xi_labels := array(nat(count), fill = -1)
    for: position < count
        xi_labels[ordering.points[position]] = xi.labels[position]
    xi_setting := Setting("xi", "xi", params.max_eps, xi_labels, [for value := core[] then value != optics.infinite_distance()])
    settings = settings.append(xi_setting)
    local int xmin := [for point := points[] then point.x].min()
    local int xmax := [for point := points[] then point.x].max()
    local int ymin := [for point := points[] then point.y].min()
    local int ymax := [for point := points[] then point.y].max()
    int[] map_columns := [for point := points[] then (point.x - xmin) * params.width / (xmax - xmin + 1)]
    int[] map_rows := [for point := points[] then (ymax - point.y) * params.height / (ymax - ymin + 1)]

    int[][] neighborhoods(int radius)
        for summary := grids[]
            if summary.radius == radius
                return summary.neighborhoods
        return []

    Setting[] db_settings()
        return [for setting := settings[] if setting.kind == "dbscan" then setting]

    Setting[] extraction_settings()
        return [for setting := settings[] if setting.kind == "extract" then setting]

    string[] labels_lines()
        names := [for setting := settings[] then setting.name]
        lines := ["id," + names.join(",")]
        for: point < count
            string[] fields := ["{points[point].id}"].concat([for setting := settings[] then "{setting.labels[point]}"])
            lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
        return lines

    string[] optics_lines()
        lines := ["order,id,core_sq,reach_sq,reach,predecessor"]
        for: position < count
            point := ordering.points[position]
            predecessor := ordering.predecessor[point]
            prior := if predecessor < 0 then "-" else "{points[predecessor].id}"
            lines = lines.append("{position + 1},{points[point].id}," + value_text(core[point]) + "," + value_text(ordering.reach[point]) + "," + root(ordering.reach[point]) + "," + prior)
        return lines

    string[] kdist_lines()
        lines := ["k_distance k {k} points {count}", "rank id kdist_sq kdist"]
        for: rank < count
            lines = lines.append("{rank + 1} {points[curve.order[rank]].id} {curve.values[rank]} " + root(curve.values[rank]))
        lines = lines.concat(["", "knee rank {curve.knee + 1} id {points[curve.order[curve.knee]].id} kdist_sq {curve.values[curve.knee]} kdist " + root(curve.values[curve.knee]) + " cross {curve.cross}", "suggested_eps {curve.eps}", "", "knee_table"])
        for: rank < int(#curves)
            row := curves[rank]
            lines = lines.append("k {rank + 1} rank {row.knee + 1} id {points[row.order[row.knee]].id} kdist_sq {row.values[row.knee]} eps {row.eps}")
        lines = lines.concat(["", "core_check"])
        for setting := db_settings()[]
            kd_count := int(#[for value := kdist[] if value <= setting.radius * setting.radius then value])
            grid_count := int(#[for value := setting.core[] if value then value])
            lines = lines.append("eps {setting.radius} core {kd_count} non_core {count - kd_count} grid_core {grid_count} " + check(kd_count == grid_count))
        defined := 0
        consistent := true
        for: point < count
            if core[point] != optics.infinite_distance()
                defined += 1
                if core[point] != kdist[point]
                    consistent = false
        return lines.append("optics max_eps {params.max_eps} core {defined} " + check(consistent))

    string[] grid_lines()
        lines := ["grid"]
        for summary := grids[]
            lines = lines.concat(summary.lines())
        return lines

    string[] check_lines(Setting setting)
        linked := true
        supported := true
        separated := true
        isolated := 0
        string[] ambiguous := []
        int[][] neighbors := neighborhoods(setting.radius)
        for: point < count
            label := setting.labels[point]
            core_labels := unique_sorted([for other := neighbors[point][] if setting.core[other] then setting.labels[other]])
            if setting.core[point]
                for other := core_labels[]
                    if other != label
                        linked = false
            elif label >= 0
                found := false
                int[] others := []
                for other := core_labels[]
                    if other == label
                        found = true
                    else
                        others = others.append(other)
                if not found
                    supported = false
                if #others > 0
                    ambiguous = ambiguous.append("  {points[point].id} cluster {label} also " + joined(others))
            else
                if #core_labels > 0
                    separated = false
                if #neighbors[point] == 1
                    isolated += 1
        return ["check " + condition(linked) + " " + condition(supported) + " " + condition(separated), "isolated {isolated}", "ambiguous {#ambiguous}"].concat(ambiguous)

    string[] setting_lines(Setting setting)
        lines := ["setting {setting.name} eps {setting.radius} clusters {setting.count} noise {setting.noise} core {setting.core_count} border {setting.border}"]
        for: label < setting.count
            lines = lines.concat(cluster_lines(points, setting, label))
        if setting.kind == "dbscan"
            lines = lines.concat(check_lines(setting))
        return lines

    string[] hierarchy_lines()
        Setting[] values := db_settings()
        int[] order := []
        for: index < int(#values)
            position := int(#order)
            order = order.append(index)
            while position > 0 and values[index].radius < values[order[position - 1]].radius
                order[position] = order[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            order[position] = index
        lines := ["hierarchy"]
        for: pair < int(#order) - 1
            smaller := values[order[pair]]
            larger := values[order[pair + 1]]
            int[][] sources := []
            for _ < larger.count
                sources = sources.append([])
            for: label < smaller.count
                for point := smaller.members[label][]
                    if smaller.core[point]
                        destination := larger.labels[point]
                        sources[destination] = sources[destination].append(label)
                        break
            lines = lines.append("{smaller.name} -> {larger.name}")
            for: label < larger.count
                clusters := if #sources[label] == 0 then "-" else joined(sources[label])
                lines = lines.append("  {label} <- " + clusters)
        return lines

    string[] comparison_lines()
        lines := ["optics_vs_dbscan"]
        for extracted := extraction_settings()[]
            reference := -1
            for: index < int(#settings)
                if settings[index].kind == "dbscan" and settings[index].radius == extracted.radius
                    reference = index
                    break
            if reference < 0
                continue
            original := settings[reference]
            mapping := array(nat(extracted.count), fill = -1)
            reverse := array(nat(original.count), fill = -1)
            same := true
            border_as_noise := 0
            for: point < count
                int first := extracted.labels[point]
                second := original.labels[point]
                if extracted.core[point]
                    if mapping[first] >= 0 and mapping[first] != second or reverse[second] >= 0 and reverse[second] != first
                        same = false
                    mapping[first] = second
                    reverse[second] = first
                if first < 0 and second >= 0
                    border_as_noise += 1
            moved := "-"
            if same
                changed := 0
                for: point < count
                    if extracted.labels[point] >= 0 and mapping[extracted.labels[point]] != original.labels[point]
                        changed += 1
                moved = "{changed}"
            partition := if same then "same" else "different"
            lines = lines.append("{extracted.name} {original.name} core_partition {partition} border_as_noise {border_as_noise} moved {moved}")
        return lines

    string[] optics_summary()
        int[] components := []
        for point := ordering.points[]
            if ordering.reach[point] == optics.infinite_distance()
                components = components.append(0)
            components[-1] += 1
        defined := int(#[for value := core[] if value != optics.infinite_distance() then value])
        singletons := int(#[for value := components[] if value == 1 then value])
        largest := components.max()
        return ["optics max_eps {params.max_eps} core {defined} components {#components} singletons {singletons} largest {largest}"]

    string[] sweep_lines()
        lines := ["sweep max_eps {params.max_eps}", "eps clusters noise largest"]
        int[] counts := []
        for: 1 <= int radius <= params.max_eps
            result := extract(ordering.points, ordering.reach, core, radius)
            setting := Setting("", "", radius, result.labels, result.core)
            largest := 0
            for members := setting.members[]
                largest = math.max(largest, int(#members))
            counts = counts.append(setting.count)
            lines = lines.append("{radius} {setting.count} {setting.noise} {largest}")
        first := 0
        best_start := -1
        best_end := -1
        for: int radius < params.max_eps
            if radius < params.max_eps - 1 and counts[radius + 1] == counts[first]
                continue
            if counts[first] >= 2 and (best_start < 0 or radius - first > best_end - best_start)
                best_start = first
                best_end = radius
            first = radius + 1
        return lines.append(if best_start < 0 then "stable -" else "stable clusters {counts[best_start]} eps {best_start + 1} {best_end + 1} length {best_end - best_start + 1}")

    string[] xi_lines()
        lines := ["xi {params.xi_text} min_size {params.min_size} steep_areas {#xi.areas}"]
        for area := xi.areas[]
            lines = lines.append("{area.kind} {area.start + 1} {area.finish + 1}")
        lines = lines.append("xi_clusters {#xi.clusters}")
        for: number < int(#xi.clusters)
            XiCluster cluster := xi.clusters[number]
            lines = lines.append("{number} start {cluster.start + 1} end {cluster.finish + 1} size {cluster.size} label " + optional(cluster.label) + " parent " + optional(cluster.parent) + " walls " + root(cluster.left) + " " + root(cluster.right) + " valley " + root(cluster.valley))
        return lines

    string[] outlier_lines()
        Outlier[] values := []
        for: point < count
            if knee.labels[point] >= 0
                continue
            nearest := -1
            best := optics.infinite_distance()
            for: other < count
                if knee.core[other]
                    int distance := optics.grid.distance(points[point], points[other])
                    if distance < best
                        best = distance
                        nearest = other
            value := Outlier(point, nearest, best)
            position := int(#values)
            values = values.append(value)
            while position > 0 and value.distance > values[position - 1].distance
                values[position] = values[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            values[position] = value
        lines := ["outliers {knee.name} count {#values}"]
        for value := values[]
            lines = lines.append("{points[value.point].id} nearest_core {points[value.nearest].id} cluster {knee.labels[value.nearest]} dist_sq {value.distance} dist " + root(value.distance))
        return lines

    string[] gap_lines()
        lines := ["gaps {knee.name}"]
        for: first < knee.count
            for: first + 1 <= second < knee.count
                best := optics.infinite_distance()
                a := -1
                b := -1
                for point := knee.members[first][]
                    for other := knee.members[second][]
                        int distance := optics.grid.distance(points[point], points[other])
                        if distance < best
                            best = distance
                            a = point
                            b = other
                lines = lines.append("{first} {second} dist_sq {best} dist " + root(best) + " between {points[a].id} {points[b].id}")
        return lines

    string[] contingency_lines()
        int[][] table := []
        for _ < knee.count + 1
            table = table.append(array(nat(xi_setting.count + 1), fill = 0))
        for: point < count
            table[knee.labels[point] + 1][xi_setting.labels[point] + 1] += 1
        lines := ["contingency {knee.name} xi", "columns " + joined(-1:<xi_setting.count)]
        for: -1 <= row < knee.count
            lines = lines.append("{row} " + joined(table[row + 1]))
        for: int column < xi_setting.count
            shared := -1
            matched := 0
            for: row < knee.count
                if table[row + 1][column + 1] > shared
                    shared = table[row + 1][column + 1]
                    matched = row
            union_size := int(#knee.members[matched]) + int(#xi_setting.members[column]) - shared
            lines = lines.append("match {column} {matched} shared {shared} jaccard " + report.fraction(shared, union_size))
        return lines

    string[] ari_lines()
        lines := ["ari"]
        for: first < int(#settings)
            for: first + 1 <= second < int(#settings)
                lines = lines.append("{settings[first].name} {settings[second].name} " + adjusted_rand(settings[first], settings[second]))
        return lines

    string[] clusters_lines()
        string[][] parts := [["points {count} min_pts {params.min_pts}", "settings " + [for setting := settings[] then setting.name].join(" ")], grid_lines()]
        for setting := settings[]
            parts = parts.append(setting_lines(setting))
        parts = parts.concat([hierarchy_lines(), comparison_lines(), optics_summary(), sweep_lines(), xi_lines(), outlier_lines(), gap_lines(), contingency_lines(), ari_lines()])
        string[] lines := []
        for: position < int(#parts)
            if position > 0
                lines = lines.append("")
            lines = lines.concat(parts[position])
        return lines

    int[] cell_members(int column, int row)
        int[] members := []
        for: point < count
            if map_columns[point] == column and map_rows[point] == row
                members = members.append(point)
        return members

    string[] cluster_map(Setting setting)
        string[] rows := []
        for: int row < params.height
            string[] characters := []
            for: int column < params.width
                int[] members := cell_members(column, row)
                labels := unique_sorted([for point := members[] if setting.labels[point] >= 0 then setting.labels[point]])
                character := if #members == 0 then " " elif #labels == 0 then "." elif #labels == 1 then label_char(labels[0]) else "*"
                characters = characters.append(character)
            rows = rows.append(characters.join(""))
        return rows

    string[] kind_map()
        string[] rows := []
        for: int row < params.height
            string[] characters := []
            for: int column < params.width
                character := " "
                for point := cell_members(column, row)[]
                    if knee.core[point]
                        character = "#"
                    elif character != "#" and knee.labels[point] >= 0
                        character = "+"
                    elif character == " "
                        character = "."
                characters = characters.append(character)
            rows = rows.append(characters.join(""))
        return rows

    Plot kdist_plot()
        int[] heights := []
        knee_column := 0
        for: int column < params.k_width
            int first := column * count / params.k_width
            int last := (column + 1) * count / params.k_width
            heights = heights.append(integer_root(params.k_height * params.k_height * curve.values[first] / curve.values[0]))
            if first <= curve.knee < last
                knee_column = column
        string[] rows := []
        for: int row < params.k_height
            string[] characters := []
            for: int column < params.k_width
                characters = characters.append(if params.k_height - row <= heights[column] then "#" elif column == knee_column then ":" else " ")
            rows = rows.append(characters.join(""))
        return Plot(rows, knee_column)

    string[] reachability_lines()
        top := [for value := positions[] if value != optics.infinite_distance() then value].max()
        columns := [for setting := settings[] if setting.kind == "extract" or setting.kind == "xi" then setting]
        names := [for setting := columns[] then setting.name]
        lines := ["reachability width {params.plot_width} max_reach " + root(top) + " columns " + names.join(" ")]
        for: position < count
            point := ordering.points[position]
            reach := ordering.reach[point]
            string bar := if reach == optics.infinite_distance() then "-" * nat(params.plot_width) else "#" * nat(integer_root(params.plot_width * params.plot_width * reach / top))
            characters := [for setting := columns[] then label_char(setting.labels[point])].join("")
            lines = lines.append(pad_left("{position + 1}", 4) + " " + pad_left("{points[point].id}", 5) + " " + pad_left(root(reach), 7) + " " + characters + " |" + bar)
        return lines

    string[] maps_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        for setting := settings[]
            lines = lines.append("map {setting.name} clusters {setting.count} noise {setting.noise}")
            lines = lines.concat(report.framed(cluster_map(setting), params.width))
            string[] legend := []
            for: label < setting.count
                legend = legend.append(label_char(label) + "={#setting.members[label]}")
            lines = lines.concat(["legend " + (if #legend == 0 then "-" else legend.join(" ")), ""])
        lines = lines.append("kinds {knee.name}")
        lines = lines.concat(report.framed(kind_map(), params.width)).append("")
        Plot plot := kdist_plot()
        lines = lines.append("kdist_plot k {k} max " + root(curve.values[0]) + " knee_column {plot.knee_column + 1}")
        lines = lines.concat(report.framed(plot.rows, params.k_width)).append("")
        return lines.concat(reachability_lines())

import math
public import grid = "./grid_index.qui"


int infinite_distance()
    return 1000000000000000000

int[] core_distances(grid.data.Point[] points, int[][] neighborhoods, int minimum)
    int[] result := []
    for: index < int(#points)
        row := neighborhoods[index]
        value := infinite_distance()
        if int(#row) >= minimum
            int[] values := [for other := row[] then grid.distance(points[index], points[other])].sorted()
            value = values[minimum - 1]
        result = result.append(value)
    return result

class Ordering(int[] points, int[] reach, int[] predecessor)

Ordering order(grid.data.Point[] points, int[][] neighborhoods, int[] core)
    count := int(#points)
    reach := array(nat(count), fill = infinite_distance())
    predecessor := array(nat(count), fill = -1)
    processed := array(nat(count), fill = false)
    int[] ordering := []
    for: start < count
        if processed[start]
            continue
        seeds := array(nat(count), fill = false)
        seeds[start] = true
        while true
            current := -1
            for: index < count
                if seeds[index] and (current < 0 or reach[index] < reach[current] or reach[index] == reach[current] and index < current)
                    current = index
            if current < 0
                break
            seeds[current] = false
            processed[current] = true
            ordering = ordering.append(current)
            if core[current] == infinite_distance()
                continue
            for other := neighborhoods[current][]
                if processed[other]
                    continue
                int candidate := math.max(core[current], grid.distance(points[current], points[other]))
                if candidate < reach[other]
                    reach[other] = candidate
                    predecessor[other] = current
                    seeds[other] = true
    return Ordering(ordering, reach, predecessor)

import math

real64 square_root(real64 value)
    result := math.sqrt(value)
    return result

real64 as_real(int value)
    converted := real64(value)
    return converted

string fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    a := math.abs(numerator)
    b := denominator
    while b != 0
        a, b = b, a % b
    return "{numerator / a}/{denominator / a}"

string root(int value)
    result := square_root(as_real(int(value)))
    return "{result:.3}"

string ari(int numerator, int denominator)
    value := as_real(int(numerator)) / as_real(int(denominator))
    formatted := "{value:.4}"
    if formatted == "-0.0000"
        formatted = "0.0000"
    return fraction(numerator, denominator) + " " + formatted

string[] framed(string[] rows, int width)
    border := "+" + "-" * nat(width) + "+"
    return [border].concat([for row := rows[] then "|" + row + "|"]).append(border)

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)
